messages:
jordan: Heads-up — canary in eu-west failed during post-render checks. Not a crash, looks like multi-chart dependency version skew affecting values resolution.
deploy-bot: Canary check failed: helm-diff exit=1. Details: chart 'payments' has a dependency change. run_id=canary-3125
maya: which dependency?
liam: payments -> billing bumped to 1.3.0 in the chart lock but our release uses values and tests for 1.2.x
jordan: exact diff snippet from the job logs:
```
M Chart 'billing' version changed: 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0
M values.billing.featureToggle: true -> false
```
maya: that featureToggle flips connection string format, might break consumers :eyes:
priya: ugh. We don't have the DB migration for 1.3.0 in this change window. Pinning sounds safer.
sam: pinning will block image promotion until we patch the chart lock. Window closes in ~45m. Do we hold the release?
jordan: proposed runway:
- abort remaining canaries (done)
- open hotfix PR that pins billing to 1.2.0 in payments Chart.yaml/chart.lock
- add a values-override to preserve featureToggle=true as a short-term mitigation
- include clear release note & follow-up ticket to upgrade to 1.3.x with migration plan
deploy-bot: Canary aborted by @jordan at 3125012350 — reason: dependency version skew
liam: alternative is to roll forward billing to 1.3.0 but that requires schema migration; not safe inside the window
maya: I can author the values override to keep featureToggle=true and submit the pin PR. Will also run a smoke dry-run.
priya: if maya can do the override, QA can run the smoke tests and give +1 in 10-15m
sam: fine — if QA green, we can re-run promotion in this window; otherwise we hold to next window and document the rollback decision.
jordan: @maya, tag me in the PR. We'll add release note: "Hold: payments chart pinned to billing v1.2.x due to values-driven incompatibility; follow-up upgrade tracked in #infra-upgrades"
maya: creating PR now, patch file: Chart.lock snippet:
```yaml
dependencies:
  - name: billing
    version: 1.2.0
```
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/payments-charts/pull/412 (draft)
deploy-bot: Dry-run available at https://ci.redwood.dev/canary-3125/dryrun (helm --dry-run produced no template errors)
priya: QA running smoke-suite on dry-run artifacts. ETA 12m.
liam: note for release notes: call out that this is a temporary pin, include the commit that upgrades to 1.3.0 when ready.
sam: ok — if QA passes, we re-run canary promotion and monitor latency/errs for 30m. If we see any regression, we rollback to previous image and keep the pin.
jordan: agreed. Also file follow-up ticket to schedule DB migration testing for billing 1.3.0 in staging (assign @liam).
liam: will do.
maya: QA green, +1 from me, applying label "canary-ready"
sam: promoting now. I'll watch the release dashboard. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Promotion started by @sam at 3125014100
maya: good job team — documenting notes in the release PR and tagging security & compliance for FYI. :thumbsup:
